name: astrorize
description: Astrorize: public website + astrologer portal + admin console (frontend/) and the Node API (backend/).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npx --prefix frontend tsc -p frontend --noEmit
